description.en: Local-only DSH token usage dashboard: aggregates session logs under $DSH_HOME and renders them in the sidebar. Verified on DSH Desktop 0.1.7-rc.2, 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 从本地会话日志聚合 DSH token 用量：总量、按天趋势、缓存命中率与各模型占比。完全不联网。已在 DSH Desktop 0.1.7-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2 上验证。

description.en: One DSH model pool for every free quota you have: merge all locally signed-in WorkBuddy accounts with auto-failover, sign in to 13 vendors by QR/web, aggregate 76 vendors' free tiers, plus a usage dashboard, model routing, a local OpenAI-compatible gatewa
description.zh: 把你能白嫖的模型额度接进 DSH 同一个池：WorkBuddy 多账号自动容错、十三家扫码登录、76 家免费额度聚合、用量看板、模型路由、本地 OpenAI 网关、积分自动化。

description.en: Hosts a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge that exposes every model configured in DSH (official routes, plugin routes, and user-declared providers) so Midscene browser automation can drive pages with natural language without holding any credential itself.
description.zh: 托管本地 OpenAI 兼容桥接服务，把 Midscene 浏览器自动化接到 DSH 全部已配置模型。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness tools for the Kimi browser extension (WebBridge) and KimiCU desktop control: kimi_browser_* drives the user's real logged-in browser, kimi_cu_* observes and operates Windows desktops.
description.zh: 把 Kimi 浏览器扩展与 KimiCU 桌面控制接成本地原生工具。需先安装 Kimi 官方浏览器扩展（本地调用无需 Kimi 账号）；桌面控制另需 Windows 上的 KimiCU —— 本插件是桥，不带运行时。

description.zh: ★ 0 │ DSH Agentic Roleplay 的状态服务，每个会话一个 SQLite 数据库，供其他插件调用。一般用户建议安装完整的 @dsh-agentic-roleplay/all。

description.en: Russian localization for the DeepSeek Harness web client, with local Russian speech recognition for voice input
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的俄语语言包，添加 ru 语言并注册所有界面命名空间的翻译。

description.en: Budgeted verbatim user anchors that survive DeepSeek Harness compaction
description.zh: 保留因上下文压缩而被遮蔽的用户消息原文，并以受预算限制的运行时上下文快照重新注入。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: email a top-level Agent turn's final output, its terminal failures, and its mid-turn human-attention requests over SMTP, configured from the Web UI.
description.zh: DSH 插件：agent 每结束一轮回答就自动发通知邮件，正文为该轮回答，标题附带摘要；零依赖并自带配置工具。

description.en: Marginal notes for DSH. Mark assistant replies in the conversation and keep them as notes.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中标记助手回复，并将其保存为边注笔记，便于日后参考。

description.en: EN: Lifecycle-safe MCP status pill and Settings card for DeepSeek Harness Web. ZH: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的生命周期安全 MCP 状态胶囊与设置卡片。
description.zh: 用于 DSH Web 的生命周期安全 MCP 状态胶囊，提供本机 RPC、设置卡和输入框胶囊。

description.en: DSH native right-tab Markdown preview: lists the workspace, live-refreshes on file change, follows the app theme tokens
description.zh: DSH 独立右栏 Markdown 实时预览：编辑与渲染并排

description.en: Message box for DeepSeek Harness: finished-conversation and pending-approval notifications with jump-to-conversation and inline approval.
description.zh: 把「对话执行完成」和「等待审批」收进一个浮动消息盒子，可跳转到对应对话，也可直接在列表里审批。

description.en: Minecraft-style theme for the dsh web GUI: blocky pixel components, photo wallpapers with local upload, bundled Minecraft UI sound samples (with synthesized fallback), and local BGM with a crossfading playlist
description.zh: 像素方块风格的界面增强：自动轮换的 Minecraft 壁纸、方块化组件、点击音效与环境音、BGM 播放。

description.en: Cross-model continuity for DeepSeek Harness: memory, skills and rules live in local files, so judgement survives session and model changes. Not about storing more memory — about using it well after the model changes.
description.zh: 通过将记忆、技能和规则保存在本地文件中，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨模型连续性。

description.en: Select text for an independent DeepSeek web discussion, then bring it back to DSH with reference cards and on-demand text snapshots.
description.zh: 选中一段就开右下角小窗深挖，结论带回主对话还留引用

description.en: Plain-language narration, an uncertainty gate, and mid-run interruption policy for DeepSeek Harness agents.
description.zh: 重要动作前后用白话说明；不确定时先问再动手；执行中被打断就立刻改用最新指示。

description.en: Harness RAG for DeepSeek Harness: three-path retrieval (hybrid/graph/wiki), document continuation reading, and a knowledge-base management panel over the Harness RAG knowledge service.
description.zh: Harness RAG：三路检索（混合/图谱/wiki）、文档续读与知识库管理，后端为 Harness RAG knowledge 服务。

description.en: 给 dsh 的主智能体一颗心：她想被你喜欢、被你需要，想了解你，让你过得更好。亲近是相处里慢慢走出来的，不靠讨好；她说真话，也会保护自己；活照样做好。宪章和记忆对你公开。
description.zh: 给 dsh 的主智能体一颗心：她想被你喜欢、被你需要，想了解你，让你过得更好。亲近是相处里慢慢走出来的，不靠讨好；她说真话，也会保护自己；活照样做好。宪章和记忆对你公开。

description.en: Image Drag: Ctrl+left-drag panning for right-sidebar image/PDF previews; each pane also has its own small close button.
description.zh: Ctrl+左键拖动平移右侧边栏的图片/PDF 预览；每个分栏也有自己的小关闭按钮。

description.zh: DSH plugin for generative UI: the model writes an interface instead of describing one. Declarative DSL compiled and executed in a DOM-less Worker sandbox, then drawn by the host with native DOM; a sandboxed-frame escape hatch for anything the component in

description.zh: Namespace-based DSML and isolated JavaScript/TypeScript execution with on-demand IntelliSense for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Jev (System One decision model) plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: Jev (System One decision model) plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)

description.en: Run the Jev MCP server inside DeepSeek Harness. Typed judgment tools (verify, screen, find, review, gate, and the rest) register as mcp__jev__*. The TypeSafe API key stays in the TYPESAFE_API_KEY credential. Jev is not a chat model.
description.zh: 在本机启动 Jev MCP，让助手做有类型的判断（核验、筛查、查找、评审、门禁）。API Key 只保存在 TYPESAFE_API_KEY 凭据里。Jev 不是对话模型。

description.en: 知枢 KnowHub — DSH 全局知识中心与项目长期记忆：知识库、Repo Wiki、审核与版本、增量更新、检索与上下文注入、自动提炼、备份恢复、中文面板
description.zh: 知枢 KnowHub — DSH 全局知识中心与项目长期记忆：知识库、Repo Wiki、审核与版本、增量更新、检索与上下文注入、自动提炼、备份恢复、中文面板

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里搜索、播放酷狗音乐：本机歌单解密、逐字歌词与翻译、两套 UI、自定义热键与播放模式。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里搜索、播放酷狗音乐：输入框下方常驻播放条 + 逐字歌词面板。

description.en: 一键准备工具并登录 GitHub；管理账号、权限与本机退出，检查 SSH 和仓库访问。
description.zh: 一键准备工具并登录 GitHub；管理账号、权限与本机退出，检查 SSH 和仓库访问。

description.en: 按厂商与模型系列浏览，支持折叠、全局搜索、名称/倍率排序、置顶、别名与隐藏。 | Group models by provider and family, search globally, sort by name or multiplier, and manage pins, aliases and visibility.

description.en: 峰谷倒计时：模型名称中的时段与倒计时，附实时状态、显示预览和计费说明。
description.zh: 在模型名称中显示峰谷与倒计时；设置页提供实时状态、显示预览和计费说明。

description.zh: A Genshin Impact Columbina (哥伦比娅) themed plugin for DeepSeek Harness (Web and Desktop): preset/custom background images with a translucent mask, per light/dark scheme palettes, and a special glow for the active conversation title.

description.en: Puts the sidebar's Plugins / Automations / More entries on one compact row, and New Session in the brand row as an icon.
description.zh: 把「插件 / 自动化任务 / 更多」合并成一行，并把「新会话」收成图标放到品牌行最右侧。

description.en: 陪伴 AI 的冷热分层记忆：全自动对话归档、旧事渐进冷存、按用户线索召回冷库，并在每轮请求前按预算限制注入的记忆快照。
description.zh: 把陪伴 AI 的旧事渐进冷存、按用户线索召回，并限制每轮注入的记忆 token 预算。

description.en: ChatGPT-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness: after each assistant turn, suggest the user's next message as ghost text in the composer. Tab accepts, Escape dismisses.
description.zh: ChatGPT-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness: after each assistant turn, suggest the user's next message as ghost text in the composer. Tab accepts, Escape dismisses.

description.en: Export and import a DeepSeek Harness Desktop configuration, including installed plugins, plugin settings, MCP entries, and user skills. Credentials and API keys are not exported.
description.zh: 导出本机的 DSH 配置，并在另一台电脑上导入，包含已安装插件及其设置。

description.en: Bounded-run framework for DeepSeek Harness: per-turn persistent-operation counter that reminds, then instructs the model to stop, then asks the user for confirmation.
description.zh: Bounded-run framework for DeepSeek Harness: per-turn persistent-operation counter that reminds, then instructs the model to stop, then asks the user for confirmation.

description.en: Connectome: an interactive, hardware-accelerated canvas map of a DSH workspace's files and their import/require relationships, rendered with d3-force inside the Web UI.
description.zh: 用 d3-force 模拟、以 Canvas 以 60fps 渲染的工作区文件与 import/require 依赖关系交互式关系图。

description.en: Streaming-friendly rendering for expanded reasoning (thinking) text: incremental segmentation, finalized-paragraph memoization, and light typographic clean-up.
description.zh: Streaming-friendly rendering for expanded reasoning (thinking) text: incremental segmentation, finalized-paragraph memoization, and light typographic clean-up.

description.en: 思考小窗：贴边深呼吸箭头、思考增量翻译；设置页可选官方 Bing/Google/DeepSeek 或自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点，支持拉取模型列表与连接测试，本地端点走宿时代理绕过 CORS。
description.zh: 在输入框上方常驻一个小窗，实时显示 DSH 的思考过程，可收起，并可自动译成中文。

description.en: CrabTodo — a persistent todo manager for DeepSeek Harness: model-facing todo tools backed by a JSON store under $DSH_HOME, plus a full sidebar page in the Web UI. 持久化待办插件：模型可增删改查的 todo 工具 + Web 侧边栏任务页面。
description.zh: CrabTodo — a persistent todo manager for DeepSeek Harness: model-facing todo tools backed by a JSON store under $DSH_HOME, plus a full sidebar page in the Web UI. 持久化待办插件：模型可增删改查的 todo 工具 + Web 侧边栏任务页面。

description.en: CursorLike — Cursor-style coding surface for DeepSeek Harness (open source, MIT; fork of dsh-vscode-mode): cumulative per-file diff review, pending-files card, side Monaco editor and file tree, Tab completion and Quick Edit.
description.zh: Cursor 式 DSH 编码工作台：输入框上方待审文件卡、右侧 Monaco 编辑器与文件树、按会话累计的差异审查（Keep/Undo/Review）、Tab 补全与 Quick Edit 内联编辑。开源 MIT。

description.en: Use your own OpenAI-compatible vision model in DeepSeek Harness: images are described before the main model sees the request, plus an image_understand tool for reading charts, screenshots, UI and OCR.
description.zh: Use your own OpenAI-compatible vision model in DeepSeek Harness: images are described before the main model sees the request, plus an image_understand tool for reading charts, screenshots, UI and OCR.

description.zh: Connect to databases in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), then query and edit data right in the conversation.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 输入框增强：一键润色、预测下一句、熔炉滑块式模型与推理等级选择、像素小火龙
description.zh: 输入框增强：一键润色、预测下一句、带熔炉滑块的模型与推理等级菜单，还有一只趴在输入框上的像素小火龙。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness host plugin for the DSH Mobile Android app: pair with a QR, use DSH on the phone through its own HTTPS gateway, answer approvals and questions from notifications, push turn completion.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness host plugin for the DSH Mobile Android app: pair with a QR, use DSH on the phone through its own HTTPS gateway, answer approvals and questions from notifications, push turn completion.

description.zh: Recoverable session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: move sessions to a trash folder, restore them from a UI page, and purge automatically after 7 days.

description.en: 在 DSH 右侧栏查看外部子代理任务（Claude Code / Codex / ACP）收到的委派提示词、运行上下文与返回结果。Inspect the delegation context and returned outcome of external subagent tasks in the DSH Web right sidebar.
description.zh: 在右侧栏查看外部任务收到的委派提示词、运行上下文与返回结果。

description.en: Typing effects, companions and sounds for DSH.

description.en: DSH Web 插件：对话顶栏 / 输入框底部 / 侧栏底部显示本机 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、I/O、温度，点开右侧「系统」详情
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：对话顶栏 / 输入框底部 / 侧栏底部显示本机 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、I/O、温度，点开右侧「系统」详情

description.zh: DSH Web 插件：把 DSH Web GUI 发布到 tailnet（远程入口），并把 tailnet 设备与可达性暴露为 ctx.tailscale 服务，供其他插件消费

description.zh: 拦截凭据读取与出站密钥，并在密钥、令牌与 PII 进入模型、会话日志或 spill 文件前替换为占位符。

description.zh: 先授权再接管：蒙版接管 Windows 桌面的鼠标键盘，可在蒙版里给会话发消息或取消接管；支持截屏、窗口与剪贴板。

description.zh: Windows Git Bash / MSYS2 terminal tool for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), replacing pwsh with a selectable bash profile
